channel.description: Latest articles from The Hartford Courant (courant.com)

item.title: Study finds warming world increases days when weather is prone to fires around the globe
item.description: Scientists say climate change drives more than half the increase.

item.title: Trump, weeks after backlash over racist post, hosts Black History Month reception
item.description: At the White House reception, Trump name-checked prominent Black Americans among his supporters.

item.title: Online seller eBay to buy secondhand fashion marketplace Depop from Etsy for $1.2B in cash
item.description: The deal comes five years after Etsy bought Depop for $1.6 billion.

item.title: Air Force One will be repainted as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 19, 2026
item.description: Small sparks could lead to brave starts now. With the emotional Moon entering bold Aries at 2:39 pm EST, following our impulses may be easier than usual. Soon after, Luna meets restrictive Saturn, asking for measured steps, simple promises, and patience as we shape plans we can actually keep. Moments later, the Moon’s contact with dreamy Neptune softens edges, encouraging us to listen from the heart. Checking the facts might ultimately be necessary, but our enthusiasm is potentially in the right

item.title: The Mighty Quinn: Hughes’ overtime goal lifts U.S. past Sweden and into semifinals
item.description: Quinn Hughes scored in overtime to put the U.S. past Sweden 2-1 after Mika Zibanejad scored to tie it late.

item.title: Guide company leading group caught in deadly avalanche warned of snow conditions days before incident
item.description: In a video posted to social media, the company urged people to "use extra caution" due to the avalanche danger.

item.title: Man who lived rent-free in New Yorker Hotel, then claimed to own it, pleads guilty to fraud charge
item.description: Mickey Barreto lived for years in the hotel rent-free after invoking an obscure tenant protection.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball survives first-half scare to clinch Big East championship at Villanova
item.description: After trailing at halftime for the first time this season, the UConn women's basketball team escaped Villanova with an 83-69 win Wednesday.

item.title: No. 5 UConn men’s basketball upset in 91-84 loss to Creighton as shaky defense shows up again
item.description: The fifth-ranked UConn men's basketball team gave up a season-high 91 points as it suffered a Quad 3 loss to Creighton at Gampel Pavilion on Wednesday.
